title: Element kernel switch to elasto-plastic path
objective: Swap elastic-only constitutive call with configurable elastic/plastic dispatch in the internal force kernel.
implementation_steps: Add constitutive model dispatch flag (elastic vs elasto-plastic)
Wire plastic constitutive emitter (P8.1) as alternative to elastic (P6.3)
Wire algorithmic tangent (P8.2) into tangent matvec
Wire history field reads/writes (P8.3) into element loop
Verify below-yield case equals elastic baseline
Verify above-yield case deviates as expected
deliverables: Updated internal force template with elastic/plastic dispatch
acceptance_criteria: Below-yield loading: results identical to elastic-only path (P6.4)
Above-yield loading: results deviate from elastic (plasticity active)
History fields updated correctly during load stepping

cases: Below yield: matches elastic baseline exactly
Above yield: deviates from elastic baseline
History fields committed on converged step
History fields rolled back on non-convergence

risks: Dispatch logic errors can silently use wrong constitutive model — verify with known loading
